```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Patch

root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent: raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root=root.parent
out=root/'assets/img/generated/veinatges.svg'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':13,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(7.4,4),layout='constrained')
for ax,mode,label in zip(axes,['rook','queen'],['Vora: 4 veïns','Vora o vèrtex: 8 veïns']):
    for x in range(3):
        for y in range(3):
            selected=abs(x-1)+abs(y-1)==1 if mode=='rook' else (x,y)!=(1,1)
            color='#990000' if (x,y)==(1,1) else '#b4c7db' if selected else '#f6f6f6'
            ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x,y),1,1,facecolor=color,edgecolor='#444444',lw=1))
    ax.text(1.5,1.5,'i',color='white',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=18)
    ax.set(xlim=(-.1,3.1),ylim=(-.1,3.1),aspect='equal',xticks=[],yticks=[],xlabel=label)
    for spine in ax.spines.values(): spine.set_visible(False)
fig.savefig(out,facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
